fact: The Minister's reply says 16,911,328 deeds documents have been digitised and made publicly accessible through the eDRS Information Provisioning Module, live since 1 April 2025, and all deeds registered after 2014 are in electronic format.
The Operation Vulindlela Q2 2026 report says work is under way to develop and pilot digital systems and tools to verify, administer and monitor the title deeds backlog.

The Minister of Land Reform's written reply (NW3407, 24 July 2026) gives budgets of R215 million for the Electronic Deeds Registration System and R13.3 million for the Cadastral Information System revamp, with eDRS hosting arranged with SITA.
